red_green.journal_ui: RED: four journal acceptance tests failed because the optional editor was absent; GREEN: journal UI tests passed after typed-client wiring, versioned save, validation, and conflict state were implemented.
red_green.today_entry: RED: two Today acceptance tests failed because the challenge list and journal entry point were absent; GREEN: Today acceptance tests passed after the account-day challenge list and detail link were added.
red_green.regression: RED: the first full frontend run exposed missing Vue Query injection in two legacy Today/App mounts; GREEN: the two direct test harnesses now install the runtime plugin and full suite passes.

acceptance_evidence.evidence: Challenge detail reads the typed journal for the authenticated account date and saves it with challenge/date identity and journal base_version.
Journal editor is separate from completion/progress controls; save payload contains only journal command fields and whitespace-only input is rejected before mutation.
Journal uses its own query/version state; stale conflict preserves the draft, displays the server snapshot, and disables blind resubmission.

scope_evidence: Slice D changed only frontend Today/Challenge UI, the journal-specific component, and direct frontend acceptance/test harness paths. Backend, contracts/openapi.yaml, and generated contract types were unchanged.
